title: Robertson panel adopts a policy of ridicule
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Robertson panel adopts a policy of ridicule, about 1952-1953 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: you know the Robertson panel in 1953 absolutely adopted this policy of ridicule

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that the Robertson panel, a 1953 group named for a scientist, H.P. Robertson, that reviewed UFO reports for the US government, deliberately adopted a policy of ridiculing the subject. He cites the panel's report as the source. If true, it would mean the stigma around UFOs in America was partly built on purpose.
